Punjab Youth Festival | Punjab Youth Festival 2012 (Urdu: پنجاب یوتھ فیسٹیول‎ ) is a sports festival held annually in Punjab, Pakistan. During the ceremony, 42,813 students sang the National Anthem in what became a Guinness World Record (GWR) for the highest number of people to have ever sung a national anthem in a live gathering.
